Louisa Bedford,. ever see'd finer horses, in my life, with manes and tails reachin' a'most to the ground, and a shinin' black hearse with a score of plumes on the top, and half a dozen men with silk hatbands walking alongside it, right away from the station to the churchyard yonder.

21037-the-cock-house-at-fellsgarth.title: The Cock House At Fellsgarth
21037-the-cock-house-at-fellsgarth.creator: Talbot Baines Reed
21037-the-cock-house-at-fellsgarth.description: A book by Talbot Baines Reed. So was not a little of the pocket-money. So, by rule immemorial, were the contents of the hampers. And so, as they discovered to their cost, were the luckless new boys who had to-day tumbled for the first time headlong into the whirlpool of public school life.

arxiv-2107-06844.title: Asymptotic interpretation of the Miles mechanism of wind-wave instability
arxiv-2107-06844.creator: A. F. Bonfils, Dhrubaditya Mitra, W. Moon, J. S. Wettlaufer
arxiv-2107-06844.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by A. F. Bonfils, Dhrubaditya Mitra, W. Moon, J. S. Wettlaufer. When wind blows over water, ripples are generated on the water surface. These ripples can be regarded as perturbations of the wind field, which is modelled as a parallel inviscid flow. For a given wavenumber k k , the perturbed streamfunction of the wind field and the complex phase speed are the eigenfunction and the eigenvalue of the so-called Rayleigh equation in a semi-infinite domain.

arxiv-2202-03799.title: What are the best systems? New perspectives on NLP Benchmarking
arxiv-2202-03799.creator: Pierre Colombo, Nathan Noiry, Ekhine Irurozki, Stephan Clémençon
arxiv-2202-03799.description: Abstract In Machine Learning, a benchmark refers to an ensemble of datasets associated with one or multiple metrics together with a way to aggregate different systems performances. They are instrumental in (i) assessing the progress of new methods along different axes and (ii) selecting the best systems for practical use.

arxiv-2207-02551.title: A Direct Construction of Cross Z-Complementary Sequence Sets with Large Set Size
arxiv-2207-02551.creator: Praveen Kumar, Sudhan Majhi, Subhabrata Paul
arxiv-2207-02551.description: Abstract This letter presents a direct construction of cross Z-complementary sequence sets (CZCSSs), whose aperiodic correlation sums exhibit zero correlation zones at both the front-end and tail-end shifts. CZCSS can be regarded as an extension of the symmetrical Z-complementary code set (SZCCS).

arxiv-2208-00521.title: DYNAMICS OF A PARTICLE IN THE GENERALISED ELLIS-BRONNIKOV WORMHOLE ON THE ROTATING ARCHIMEDE’S SPIRAL
arxiv-2208-00521.creator: N. GIORGADZE, Z.N. OSMANOV
arxiv-2208-00521.description: Abstract A particle moving on curved magnetic field lines in the wormhole metrics is considered. The dynamics of a single particle is studied on a co-rotating parameterized magnetic field line. Being interested in the force-free dynamics we choose the rotating Archimedes’ spiral embedded in the generalized Ellis-Bronnikov metrics.

arxiv-2305-14380.title: Finding the Pillars of Strength for Multi-Head Attention
arxiv-2305-14380.creator: Jinjie Ni, Rui Mao, Zonglin Yang, Han Lei, Erik Cambria
arxiv-2305-14380.description: Abstract Recent studies have revealed some issues of Multi-Head Attention (MHA), e.g., redundancy and over-parameterization. Specifically, the heads of MHA were originally designed to attend to information from different representation subspaces, whereas prior studies found that some attention heads likely learn similar features and can be pruned without harming performance.

arxiv-2312-03344.title: Interpretable Mechanistic Representations for Meal-level Glycemic Control in the Wild
arxiv-2312-03344.creator: Ke Alexander Wang, Emily B. Fox
arxiv-2312-03344.description: Abstract Diabetes encompasses a complex landscape of glycemic control that varies widely among individuals. However, current methods do not faithfully capture this variability at the meal level. On the one hand, expert-crafted features lack the flexibility of data-driven methods; on the other hand, learned representations tend to be uninterpretable which hampers clinical adoption.

arxiv-2501-17321.title: The highest energy cosmic rays from superheavy dark matter particles
arxiv-2501-17321.creator: E. V. Arbuzova
arxiv-2501-17321.description: Abstract It is commonly accepted that high energy cosmic rays up to 10 19 10^{19} eV can be produced in catastrophic astrophysical processes. However the source of a few observed events with higher energies remains mysterious. We propose that they may originate from decay or annihilation of ultra heavy particles of dark matter.

arxiv-2506-14028.title: MultiFinBen: A Multilingual, Multimodal, and Difficulty-Aware Benchmark for Financial LLM Evaluation
arxiv-2506-14028.creator: Xueqing Peng 1 , Lingfei Qian 1 , Yan Wang 1 , Ruoyu Xiang 6 , Yueru He 3 , Yang Ren 1 , Mingyang Jiang 1 , Jeff Zhao 1 , Huan He 1 , Yi Han 4 , Yun Feng 17 , Yuechen Jiang 7 , Yupeng Cao 7 , Haohang Li 7 , Yangyang Yu 7 , Xiaoyu Wang 6 , Penglei Gao 8 , Shengyuan Lin 20 , Keyi Wang 3 , Shanshan Yan
arxiv-2506-14028.description: Abstract Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have accelerated progress in financial NLP and applications, yet existing benchmarks remain limited to monolingual and unimodal settings, often over-relying on simple tasks and failing to reflect the complexity of real-world financial tasks.

arxiv-2508-13694.title: Global well-posedness for a time-fractional doubly nonlinear equation
arxiv-2508-13694.creator: Goro Akagi, Giacomo Enrico Sodini, Ulisse Stefanelli
arxiv-2508-13694.description: Abstract . We consider a time-fractional parabolic equation of doubly nonlinear type, featuring nonlinear terms both inside and outside the differential operator in time. The main nonlinearities are maximal monotone graphs, without restrictions on the growth. In addition, a Lipschitz continuous perturbation is considered. The existence of global weak solutions is obtained via a regularization and Galerkin approximation method.

pmc-10625384.title: Long-Term Outcome and Complications of IOL-Exchange
pmc-10625384.creator: David A Märker, Viola Radeck, Teresa Barth, Horst Helbig, Nicolas C D Scherer
pmc-10625384.description: PurposeTo describe the long-term outcome after intraocular lens (IOL) exchange for IOL-opacification with a focus on any occurring complications.Patients and MethodsPatients with an IOL exchange for opacified IOLs (Lentis LS-502-1) were identified. Medical records and information from the treating ophthalmologists were reviewed. Visual outcomes and any occurring complications after the IOL exchange were analyzed.

pmc-11328598.title: Systemic immunoinflammatory indexes in albuminuric adults are negatively associated with α-klotho: evidence from NHANES 2007–2016
pmc-11328598.creator: Meng Jia, Shisheng Han, Yi Wang
pmc-11328598.description: BackgroundSystemic Immune-Inflammation Index (SII) is a novel inflammatory biomarker closely associated with the inflammatory response and chronic kidney disease. Klotho is implicated as a pathogenic factor in the progression of kidney disease, and supplementation of Klotho may delay the progression of chronic kidney disease by inhibiting the inflammatory response.

pmc-11487192.creator: Yohei Matsunaga, Hiroshi Qadota, Nasab Ghazal, Leila Lesanpezeshki, Till Dorendorf, Jasmine C Moody, Arnaud Ahier, Courtney J Matheny, Siva A Vanapalli, Steven Zuryn, Olga Mayans, Jennifer Q Kwong, Guy M Benian
pmc-11487192.description: UNC-89 is a giant sarcomeric M-line protein required for sarcomere organization and optimal muscle function. UNC-89 contains two protein kinase domains, PK1 and PK2, separated by an elastic region. Here we show that PK2 is a canonical kinase expected to be catalytically active. C.

pmc-11494822.title: Indirect modeling of derived outcomes: Are minor prediction discrepancies a cause for concern?
pmc-11494822.creator: John P Prybylski
pmc-11494822.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). It is often a goal of model development to predict data from which a variety of outcomes can be derived, such as threshold‐based categorization or change from baseline (CFB) transformations. This approach can improve power or support multiple decisions. Because these derivations are indirectly predicted from the model, they are valuable tests for misspecification when used in visual or numeric predictive checks (V/NPCs).

pmc-12469502.title: Effect of Prehabilitation on the 6-Minute Walk Test and Length of Hospital Stay in Frail Older People: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
pmc-12469502.creator: María López-González, Celia Álvarez-Bueno, Beatriz Rodríguez-Martín, Patricia Lorenzo-García, Marta Carolina Ruiz-Grao, Susana Priego-Jiménez, Francisco José Tarazona-Santabalbina
pmc-12469502.description: Frailty reduces resilience to surgical stress, increasing vulnerability to adverse outcomes. While recovery efforts traditionally focus on the postoperative phase, the preoperative period offers better opportunities for lifestyle interventions. Prehabilitation aims to increase functional reserve and surgical tolerance, especially in frail older adults.

pmc-12490818.title: Stomal Hyperflow and Intestinal Failure: A Case Report on the Use of a Chyme Reinstillation Device
pmc-12490818.creator: Florian Poncelet, Thierry Van Der Linden, Sabrina Dardenne, Edouard-Florent Pourbaix, Emmanuel Floret
pmc-12490818.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Stomal hyperflow, a frequent complication of ileostomy, is associated with high morbidity and mortality, particularly when linked to intestinal failure. This situation, especially when conventional treatments fail, often results in a poor prognosis for the patient.In this case report, we present the history of a patient suffering from stomal hyperflow with intestinal failure, in the context of short small bowel syndrome following multifocal venous mesenteric ischaemia.

pmc-12520645.title: Implementing a Digital Mental Health Intervention—the Lumi Nova App—to Support Children With Anxiety in Economically Disadvantaged Areas: Mixed Methods Study
pmc-12520645.creator: Pauline Whelan, Heidi Tranter, Lesley-Anne Carter, John Sainsbury, Manjul Rathee, Charlotte Stockton-Powdrell, Niamh Bolton, Kathryn Mary Abel, Denise Kuo, Terika McCall
pmc-12520645.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundAnxiety is one of the most common mental health problems experienced by children worldwide. In the United Kingdom, many children experiencing anxiety do not receive adequate or timely help. Children living in economically disadvantaged areas experience more mental health problems than those living in high-income areas and are less able to engage in activities that can have a positive or protective impact on their mental health.

pmc-12559656.title: Pregnancy Complicated by Ruptured Degenerating Leiomyoma and Hemoperitoneum: Case Report
pmc-12559656.creator: Bahar Farshidfar, Keihan Shabankhani, Narjes Mohammadi, Aghdas Ebadi Jamkhane, Mohammadhossein Esfahani
pmc-12559656.description: Uterine fibroids are the most common benign gynecologic tumors; in pregnancy, degeneration may occur but is uncommon, whereas spontaneous rupture is an exceedingly rare complication. We present the case of a 43-year-old woman, gravida 2 para 2, at 17 weeks and 6 days of gestation, who was admitted with progressive abdominal pain and distension.

pmc-13023347.title: Horse Olfactory Exploration of Various Plants with Regard to Smell and Taste Familiarity
pmc-13023347.creator: Elżbieta Wnuk, Wiktoria Janicka, Anna Stachurska, Kamila Janicka, Marta Wnęk, Wojciech Jagusiak, Jarosław Łuszczyński
pmc-13023347.description: Simple SummaryThe senses of taste and smell are important in food selection and acceptance. Horses may exhibit a neophobic response to a novel odour or flavour, and they usually show preferences for known feed. The current study investigated if previous experience with the smell and taste of herbal plants influences horses’ olfactory exploration of those plants.

pmc-13382170.title: Survey data on consumer responses to social media-endorsed FMCG advertising in Vietnam
pmc-13382170.creator: Thuy Duong Pham, Huong Thi Lan Le, Hai Ninh Nguyen
pmc-13382170.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This article presents a survey dataset on consumer responses to social media-endorsed advertising in Vietnam’s fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) sector. Data were collected through a cross-sectional online survey administered in Google Forms and distributed via relevant Facebook groups in Vietnam between August and December 2025, using a non-probability purposive sampling approach targeting adult social media users with recent exposure to influencer-endorsed FMCG advertising.

uslaw-usc-t26-s6401.title: 26 U.S.C. § 6401 — Amounts treated as overpayments
uslaw-usc-t26-s6401.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t26-s6401.description: United States Code, Title 26 (Internal Revenue Code); Chapter 65 (Abatements, Credits, And Refunds); Subchapter A (Procedure In General). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Assessment and collection after limitation period. The term “overpayment” includes that part of the amount of the payment of any internal revenue tax which is assessed or collected after the expiration of the period of limitation properly.
